Question B-007-006-007.

Why the correct answer is right: The 20-metre band is one of the reliable daytime long-distance HF bands and can support worldwide paths at many phases of the solar cycle.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Only at the minimum point of the solar cycle": Only at the minimum point of the solar cycle is too restrictive; 20 metres is not limited to solar minimum.
- sourceIndex 2: "Only at the maximum point of the solar cycle": Only at the maximum point of the solar cycle is also too restrictive; 20 metres often works outside maximum.
- sourceIndex 3: "At the beginning of the solar cycle": At the beginning of the solar cycle names an arbitrary phase rather than the band's broad usefulness.
